name: @hwfee/dsh-context-rail
description: DeepSeek Harness 的会话内上下文侧栏插件：在会话标题栏右侧的按钮排里加一个开关，宽屏自动展开；侧栏贴着会话内容流右缘，不占用宿主原生右栏（文件预览、文件树等照常），显示当前会话的目录、模型、上下文窗口占用与分段、Token 用量。 / In-page session rail for DeepSeek Harness: a toggle in the conversation header's utility row, auto-opened on wide windows; it sits at the conversation's right edge without occupying the native right sidebar, and shows the session's environment, context occupancy and token usage.
author: HwFee <1744567281@qq.com>
